releaseNotes: Removes the temporary 'Hier tippen' helper box from Notes Text mode
Text blocks can now be placed anywhere on the page by tapping a free position
Text fields are created directly in the trusted pointer gesture and focused immediately for improved BOOX keyboard activation
Legacy delayed text placement is suppressed to prevent the text field from flashing and disappearing
Existing Pen, Marker, formatting and deletion confirmation behavior is retained
No new APK is required; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
